rectConvention: Pillow half-open [left,top,right,bottom], explicitly authored, no inferred bounds
reuse: Facade is copied upright onto south/west and hidden east/north, never silently mirrored. Hidden walls stretch the same full panel over 128 units.
relief: Authored piecewise planar window/door recesses, jambs, cornice ledges/brackets, entry treads and parapet coping/inner walls correspond to explicit atlas UV cells. Original painted fine bevels, stair taper, lamp and weathering remain baked. Roof ventilator remains separately registered 2.5D paint, not geometry. See geometry-controls.json and output/mesh.json.
sourceCitation: Adapted byte-identical atlas from docs/review/stone-painted-facade-20261116/inputs/atlas.png, cropped by unchanged half-open rectangles. No benchmark pixels sampled.
perspectiveCorrection: The original D108 prism basis was not wrong. New geometric offsets and horizontal treads replace flat-plane-only depth at named boundaries. Painted fine shading is not a fully perspective-free material and is not claimed corrected at every texel.
